subject: Biology
topic: Chapter introduction: Cell, the Building Block of Life
title: Cell: Chapter Introduction
summary: You began as a single cell. Every living thing is built of cells: how they were discovered, what is inside, how they divide, and the cell theory.
keyPoints: Every human begins as **one cell**; an adult body has **trillions** of cells.
All living things are made of cells; an **amoeba** or a bacterium is a single cell.
**Robert Hooke** (1665) saw tiny box-like compartments in thin cork slices and named them **cells**.
A cell has a **cell membrane**, a **nucleus** and **organelles** such as mitochondria; it makes new cells by **division** (1 → 2 → 4 ...).

list: All living things are made of one or more cells.
The cell is the basic structural and functional unit of life.
New cells arise only from pre-existing cells (by division).
